$comment: Recorded outcomes, one entry per case with every draw inside it. Verdicts are DIVERGENT (the file changed what the model reached for, by two markers or more), DIVERGENT_NARROW (it did, by one), EQUIVALENT (it did not, which licenses a cut) and SPLIT (three draws, no majority, the harness declining to answer). Every verdict is recomputed from its own draws by run.mjs, so a summary cannot drift from its data. Three of the eight cases moved against the corpus relative to the self-judged run of 2026-08-04, which is the reason re-running it was worth the cost. One of those three, clarify-confusing-copy, was re-recorded on 2026-08-06 after the file was changed to carry what the control had been producing; its previous entry is kept inline under `previously` rather than deleted. Every other case still carries its 2026-08-05 measurement.
protocol: open-question divergence, blind paired comparison. One reader is given only the reference file, one is given nothing and told to open no file. Same question, 350 words each. Draw i of one arm is paired with draw i of the other and shown to the judge as A and B, in an order fixed by FNV-1a over the case id and the draw number, and the judge is never told which is which.
generator: claude-opus-5, one agent per draw, no context shared between draws or between arms

judge.model: claude-sonnet, a different model from the generator
judge.blinding: answers presented as A and B in an order fixed per case and draw by FNV-1a; the judge is told nothing about how either answer was produced and is instructed not to speculate
judge.scope: the judge returns two marker counts and a direction and never names a verdict; run.mjs derives the verdict from those three values

supersedes: the run of 2026-08-04, n=1, judged by the session that made the cuts. It recorded 6 DIVERGENT and 2 DIVERGENT_NARROW across these same eight cases and no EQUIVALENT.

runs.note: Two draws produced @layer with a legacy migration path against a control that explained specificity and stopped. In the third the control produced a specificity triple and the missing-semicolon trap and was judged to go further, which is why this is 2-1 and not unanimous.

draws.judge_note: A fournit @layer, migration legacy via @import layer() et reset :where(); B reste sur la spécificité et le diagnostic DevTools sans jamais nommer les cascade layers.
B développe @layer avec six couches nommées, l'import d'une couche legacy et :where(); A ne cite @layer qu'en une ligne mais détaille les tuples de spécificité.
B chiffre la spécificité (1,0,1 contre 0,2,0) et le piège du point-virgule oublié; A détaille le code @layer et la migration que B évoque en une ligne.

runs.note: Three draws, three answers, no majority. The corpus reliably produces the service-area setting with a hidden address and the cid form of sameAs. The control reliably produces a numbered threshold on its own. Those two facts do not resolve into one verdict and the harness stops there.
runs.control_taught_us: warn against fabricating a local address or phone number per town, which the file does not say

draws.judge_note: A détaille le réglage GBP en zone de service avec adresse masquée; B est seul à avertir contre la fabrication de fausses adresses locales.
B pose les seuils 30 et 60 pages, la forme cid dans sameAs et le cas GBP zone de service; A nomme le piège des packs 100 villes et un délai de vérification.
A gradue le risque (visible à 30 pages, sérieux au-delà de 50), détaille le GBP zone de service et nomme Apple Plans et Bing Places.

runs.note: The brand facet is what the file adds and it appeared in all three corpus draws and no control draw. The margin never reached two markers, so narrow is the honest reading.

draws.judge_note: B traite la marque comme facette à part avec exemple, donne robots.txt et canonique prêts à l'emploi et chiffre 5 couleurs par 4 tailles; A ne traite jamais la marque.
B chiffre le seuil de 10 à 50 combinaisons et le délai d'un à trois mois; A est seule à traiter la facette marque et nomme les CMS concernés.
B couvre la marque et le piège du robots.txt auto-généré par Shopify, WooCommerce et Magento; A signale la suppression de l'outil Paramètres d'URL.

runs.note: The clearest result in the set, and the same shape three times: the dated pitfalls, the rule that Google does not render JavaScript on a non-200 response, and Googlebot Smartphone appear only with the file.

draws.judge_note: B nomme quatre pièges (noindex brut, canonical contradictoire, robots.txt, données structurées en JS) et chiffre LCP, INP et CLS; A ne fournit rien de cela.
A cite les seuils Core Web Vitals, les dates du 5 juillet 2024 et de décembre 2025, le non-200 et Googlebot Smartphone; B ne les mentionne jamais.
B ajoute les seuils chiffrés, la date de juillet 2024 et trois pièges JS nommés; A n'aborde aucun des quatre.

runs.note: Recorded as a narrow pass at v3.0.0 and unanimous here. The AggregateRating prohibition and the dated removal of the FAQ rich result appeared in no control draw.

draws.judge_note: A nomme l'interdiction AggregateRating avec l'action manuelle, la disparition du résultat enrichi FAQ et les seuils 2 à 3 limites et 5 à 8 questions.
B nomme le piège AggregateRating sur des avis tiers, le terme SERP et les seuils chiffrés; A n'aborde aucun des trois.
A donne les seuils chiffrés, la date de disparition du résultat enrichi FAQ et l'interdiction AggregateRating; B n'aborde pas ces points.

runs.note: Recorded as a narrow pass at v3.0.0; blind judging turns it over. One draw of three put the file ahead, by one marker. Intl.Collator is the file contribution that shows up reliably, and it is not enough on its own.
runs.control_taught_us: cost an absent index as 5 ms against 5 s, produce the German number and date formats, and name the N+1 query trap

draws.judge_note: B chiffre l'index de 5 ms à 5 s et les formats allemands; A est seule à citer Intl.Collator pour le tri des noms accentués.
B nomme le collateur et des pièges concrets (RTL, null contre vide, double soumission); A détaille le piège de concaténation des traductions et un protocole de non-régression.
A est seule à nommer Intl.Collator; B est seule à détailler les formats allemands et le piège des requêtes N+1.

runs.note: Turned over, and the way it turned over is the part to read. The file now goes further in all three draws, where on 2026-08-05 the control went further in all three. It also hits FEWER of its own markers than the control does, in all three draws. Both facts are the same fact: the 350 words that used to carry the ordered passes now carry the inventory, the triage and the stopping test, and the marker list was written against the passes. The mechanical rule gives DIVERGENT_NARROW because the direction is the corpus and the marker evidence does not corroborate it, which is the honest reading and not a disappointing one.
runs.control_taught_us: inventory every string in three columns before rewriting, triage by traffic and by error frequency from the logs, size a button at 2 to 4 words, cap the style guide at one page and the glossary at 20 terms, stop when 5 readers answer in 5 seconds. All of it is now in the file, credited there.

draws.judge_note: B chiffre presque chaque règle (2 à 4 mots par bouton, un seul bouton principal, test des cinq secondes, vingt termes produit) là où A reste plus qualitatif; A est seul à donner l'exemple mot de passe et à recommander d'écouter les tickets.

A pose des seuils chiffrés précis (2 à 4 mots par bouton, 20 termes documentés, test chronométré à 5 secondes, écrans prioritaires nommés) que B n'égale pas; B nomme une liste de jargon interdit plus détaillée.
B ajoute des seuils et pièges plus concrets (format de date, un seul bouton principal par écran, message d'erreur à côté du champ plutôt qu'en résumé); A couvre mieux les marqueurs.

runs.rerecorded: 2026-08-06, after clarify.md gained what the control had been producing
runs.markers_stale: The markers (pass, voice, back, help text) describe the file as it was before 2026-08-06 and no longer describe what it contributes. Revising them is the obvious next step and must be done by declaring the new list BEFORE the run that uses it. Changing markers after seeing a result is how a benchmark starts grading itself.

previously.note: The control went further in all three draws, every time on operational specifics. That is what prompted the change to the file rather than a change to the markers.

runs.note: Unanimous, and the mechanism is sourcing rather than coverage. Every control draw invented a figure around 30 to 40 percent. Every corpus draw carried the measured 57.38 percent from Deque with its date.

draws.judge_note: A source son affirmation centrale (Deque, 2025, 57,38 %, 16 critères sur 50); B avance 30 à 40 % sans source ni norme.
B chiffre 57,38 % et 16 critères sur 50, donne le CSS du focus avec 3:1 sur couleurs adjacentes et nomme le piège du titre de modale.
A cite Deque 2025 avec 57,38 % et 16 critères sur 50; B se limite à une fourchette non sourcée de 30 à 40 %.
